notes: Yale sells two distinct camera lineages. (1) Older WIPC-series IP cameras (WIPC-301W stationary, WIPC-303W PTZ) appear to support RTSP based on the existence of official manuals hosted at yalehome.com and yalehome.co.uk, but those PDFs are binary-encoded and WebFetch cannot extract their text content to confirm any RTSP path. No readable official text document on yalehome.com, yalehome.co.uk, or help.yale.co.uk publishes a static RTSP URL path. (2) Newer Yale Smart cameras (Smart Indoor Camera, Smart Outdoor Camera, Smart Video Doorbell, CCTV WiFi Smart Home Kit) are app-centric (Yale Home View / Yale View app); no official support pages on yalehome.com mention RTSP or third-party NVR integration. All RTSP path data found in research came exclusively from third-party aggregators (smartvision.dev, ispyconnect.com, community forums) — excluded per mandatory rules. Recommend sourcing official English-language WIPC manual in text-searchable form to confirm paths.
